answer: Proof of Work acts as a computational harbor where AI agents must expend verifiable energy to validate network state, creating a cost barrier against Sybil attacks. An attacker attempting to spiral into illicit dominance faces a dune of prohibitive hardware expenses, as the resource-intensive nature of mining ensures that each identity carries a tangible fiscal burden. This economic friction prevents the mass generation of fake identities, effectively securing the decentralized consensus through measurable digital labor.
